timeline.value: Your acknowledgment, demand draft, if any, and proofs, should reach Protean within 15 days from the date of online application.
timeline.quote: Your acknowledgment, demand draft, if any, and proofs, should reach Protean within 15 days from the date of online application.

issuing_authority.quote: The acknowledgment duly signed, affixed with photographs (in case of 'Individuals') along with Demand Draft, if any, and proof of identity & proof of address as specified in the application form is to be sent to Protean at 'INCOME TAX PAN SERVICES UNIT, Managed by Protean eGov Technologies Limited 4th Floor, Sapphire Chambers, Baner Road, Baner, Pune - 411045.'

steps.value: Applicant registers by selecting Form No. 95 / Form No. 96 along with category and title, enters required details, and submits to generate a token number.
steps.quote: Applicant will initially register by selecting Form No. 95 / Form No. 96 along with category and title of the applicant and enter the required details and submit. A token number will be generated and displayed to the applicant before filling the form.

steps.value: If the data submitted fails in any format level validation, an error response is displayed on the screen and the applicant shall rectify and re-submit.
steps.quote: If the data submitted fails in any format level validation, a response indicating the error(s) will be displayed on the screen. The applicant shall rectify the error(s) and re-submit the form.

steps.value: If there are no format level errors, a confirmation screen with filled data is displayed for editing or confirmation.
steps.quote: If there are no format level error(s), a confirmation screen with data filled by the applicant will be displayed. The applicant may either edit or confirm the same.

steps.value: On confirmation and successful payment, an acknowledgment screen is displayed and a PDF receipt is sent via email.
steps.quote: On confirmation, and in case of credit card / debit card / net banking payment (on successful payment), an acknowledgment screen with downloadable acknowledgement receipt will be displayed. An e-mail containing this acknowledgement receipt (in PDF) as well as payment receipt (in PDF) as attachments will be sent to applicant's e-mail ID mentioned in the application.

steps.value: Applicant saves and prints the acknowledgment, affixes photographs and signature as required, and sends it with proofs and demand draft to Protean within 15 days.
steps.quote: Applicant shall save and print this acknowledgment. ... The acknowledgment duly signed, affixed with photographs (in case of 'Individuals') along with Demand Draft, if any, and proof of identity & proof of address as specified in the application form is to be sent to Protean at 'INCOME TAX PAN SERVICES UNIT, Managed by Protean eGov Technologies Limited 4th Floor, Sapphire Chambers, Baner Road, Baner, Pune - 411045.'
